architecture.head: OBB26
architecture.input: RGB, 1024x1024 (larger inputs are windowed with 200 px overlap)
architecture.dual_head: one-to-many (NMS) + one-to-one (NMS-free); inference here uses the NMS path (better on dense scenes: monitor mAP50 0.821 vs 0.810 for the NMS-free head at epoch 0)

caveats: large-vehicle: measured precision ~44% at its operating point (conf=0.105) - roughly 56% of large-vehicle detections are expected to be wrong at the default threshold
